label: 断罪大薙ぎ
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. FOUR-frame DANGEROUS ACTION 断罪大薙ぎ by 黒曜の処刑者 EXACT 2x2. Ordered: frame1 anticipation, frame2 held windup, frame3 powerful release, frame4 recovery. Trajectory: double axe blade pulls to right shoulder (750,350), both hands hold haft at (560,430), blade sweeps across left (140,610), returns. Waist twists 20 degrees, planted feet. Exaggerated late-game weight and force, distinct readable poses, secondary cape/tail follows with lag. Body sheet only; tiny attached core/palm glow allowed, full attack VFX separate. Match the FIRST fixed canonical reference identity, palette, proportions, face, armor, weapons, wing/tail attachments and refined JRPG pixel art: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, stepped edges, dark outline, no airbrush or 3D render. LEFT-facing mild 3/4 view. All complete silhouettes have 12% clear margin in their own equal cells; no clipped tails, blades, wings, horns, fingers or feet. Same scale across every frame, true transparent alpha. No background, floor slab, shadow plate, labels, grid, checkerboard, text, watermark, extra creatures or detached body parts. Female characters remain clearly adults, dressed/armored as reference.  Each cell local 0..1024. Body root (540,550), head around (330,350) for bipeds or (300,520) for quadrupeds. Ground contacts y=850. Whole silhouette in x=100..920,y=120..880. Coordinates are movement targets, not evidence of output compliance.
reviewStatus: all source frames visually reviewed; playback and runtime acceptance pending

observations: 発動で斧を水平に左へ大きく押し出す。
issues: 溜めが肩へ引く姿勢より頭上姿勢になり、断層斬と区別しにくい。大薙ぎ専用の肩・腰の回転を整理する。
頭上の刃と発動の左先端、マントの見切れを検収する。
